name: yichayun-trade-data
description: Global customs trade data at your fingertips: find overseas buyers and suppliers by product, analyze market trends and partner-country shares, and look up company profiles and credit standing. Built on original shipment records and official statistics with clear time coverage.

display.name: 易查云贸易数据
display.description_zh: 全球海关贸易数据智能查询:按产品找海外采购商与供应商,分析市场趋势与伙伴国份额,查企业画像与资信。数据来自提单与官方统计原始记录,带明确时间口径,可追溯、可对账。
